prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: one square mobile visual-search training photograph. Create a single coherent realistic photograph, never a collage or a contact sheet. Use soft even daylight, balanced midtone exposure, natural colors, realistic proportions and a clean unobtrusive background. Keep the main subject centered with generous safe margins on every edge; it must read clearly as a small square thumbnail. No text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, recognizable brands, frames, watermarks or graphic symbols. Food-only photograph of a thick pink strawberry dessert milkshake in a clear glass, topped with a visible swirl of whipped cream and a drizzle of strawberry syrup on a pale wooden table. Single serving, three-quarter overhead view, entire food and dish visible with at least 10 percent safe margins. Food occupies around two thirds of the square. No people, hands, faces or packaging.
